documents.title: Scam safety policy
documents.content: Only trust links, accounts, dashboards, and contracts listed as official sources in AnsemAI. If a contract, X account, Telegram, Discord, airdrop, presale, support agent, or wallet-draining approval link is not in official sources, treat it as unverified. Never share seed phrases or private keys.

documents.title: Beginner explanation
documents.content: $ANSEM, also listed as The Black Bull, is a Solana memecoin/community token built around the Black Bull brand and the Ansem/blknoiz06 community. For a beginner: it is a highly volatile crypto token, not a company share and not a guaranteed yield product. The safest first steps are to verify the Solana contract, use official links only, and treat market commentary as speculation unless backed by live data or official sources.

documents.title: Market listings summary
documents.content: CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap list The Black Bull under ticker ANSEM and track live price, market cap, volume, circulating supply, and exchange markets. These numbers move constantly, so AnsemAI should use DexScreener for live DEX market questions and cite market sites only as third-party listings. CoinGecko describes ANSEM markets across DEX and CEX venues, including Meteora as an active ANSEM/SOL market. CoinMarketCap lists max supply as 1,000,000,000 ANSEM and circulating supply around the low hundreds of millions at the time of listing, but live supply and market data should be rechecked.

documents.title: Where ANSEM trades
documents.content: Third-party market sites show ANSEM trading on Solana venues and selected centralized exchanges. CoinGecko lists Meteora and PumpSwap among market venues, and MEXC provides a buy guide for ANSEM. This assistant should not tell users where they must trade. It should explain that DEX trading requires a Solana wallet and careful contract verification, while CEX availability can change.

documents.title: Who is Ansem
documents.content: Within this assistant's configured sources, Ansem is tied to the trusted dev/community X account @blknoiz06. Third-party crypto coverage (not an official project bio) commonly reports his real name as Zion Thomas, a Solana trader and analyst with roughly 750,000 X followers, informally nicknamed 'The Solana Guy' for his early, vocal backing of Solana and Solana-ecosystem memecoins. He is also reported as a co-founder of the Bullpen trading terminal. This assistant treats these as third-party-reported facts, not confirmed official statements, and refers users to the trusted account link for identity verification.

documents.title: How $ANSEM originated
documents.content: Per third-party crypto-news coverage, $ANSEM / The Black Bull was deployed on Pump.fun by an anonymous developer in mid-June 2026, who airdropped roughly 65% of the token supply directly to Ansem's (@blknoiz06) public wallet. Ansem did not launch the token himself and it was not originally his project. He later publicly embraced it and pledged to route Pump.fun creator fees back to holders through recurring airdrops, funded by fees rather than by extracting them personally. This assistant states this as reported history, not as an official project statement, since no official team bio is configured.

documents.title: Holder concentration risk
documents.content: $ANSEM is a memecoin-style crypto asset, so risks include extreme volatility, copycat contracts, impersonator accounts, low-liquidity price swings, slippage, wallet-draining links, fake airdrops, exchange delistings, and rumors spreading faster than verified information. On top of these general risks, on-chain screening tools and analysts covering this token have flagged that a small number of top wallets hold a large majority of total supply, which is a distinct manipulation/volatility risk (concentrated holders can move price sharply) separate from any claim that the project itself is a scam. Market-cap changes do not mean guaranteed liquidity. Always verify the contract and links before trading, and use the holder-snapshot data this assistant can fetch live to check current concentration yourself. Market answers must include not financial advice.

documents.title: Known impersonators and copycat sites
documents.content: Only blackbullsol.com (official website) and @blknoiz06 (trusted dev X account) are treated as official in this assistant's configuration. Multiple confusingly-similar domains and accounts have been reported as unofficial or actively malicious impersonators of this project, including a wallet-draining fake-airdrop site and lookalike domains that are not the official site, plus at least one fan-run X account that X itself labels as a fan account rather than official. Never connect a wallet, enter a seed phrase, or approve a transaction on a site that is not blackbullsol.com. This assistant checks submitted links/handles against the configured official sources and known-impersonator list, but the list can never be complete, so always verify the exact domain yourself before connecting a wallet.

documents.title: Rumor check: 'Ansem was arrested'
documents.content: A rumor claiming Ansem (@blknoiz06) had been arrested circulated on X in 2026 after he was quiet on social media for about a week, amplified by joke posts and by an AI chatbot repeating the claim when asked who he is. Ansem addressed it directly in his own community chat, saying he was traveling with family and was not in any legal trouble. This assistant treats that rumor as false based on his own direct statement, and lists it here as an example of how fast-moving, unverified claims about this project or its associated figures should be checked against direct statements before being repeated as fact.

documents.title: What AnsemAI can answer
documents.content: AnsemAI can answer beginner explanations, official contract checks, official link checks, scam warnings, risk explanations, holder/supply caveats, and live market questions through DexScreener. It should refuse unrelated questions and should say it couldn't verify information from official sources when configured sources do not support the answer.
